facts.text: Serve the mains when Frank checks into his hotel suite fresh out of prison.
facts.why: Frank goes back to his Plaza Hotel suite after prison rather than checking in; the transcript has him telling people he is at the Plaza.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Frank walks back into his Plaza suite fresh out of prison.

facts.text: A black tie dinner to keep the hospital doors open
facts.why: Frank raises money to keep the South Bronx hospital open through a televised charity fundraiser. Nothing shows a black tie dinner.
facts.fix: A benefit night to keep the hospital doors open

vibe.verdict: A stylish benefit night with the $16 million pledge card, but the food could be more Frank White and the film's lines go unused.
missing: 'Back from the dead!' (Frank and Pete Hamill)
'I'm gonna run for mayor!' (the press moment)
Jimmy Jump and Test Tube (the crew)
The chicken restaurant where Jimmy is arrested (Colombians)
'I thought people like me were the legal process' (Frank and Jennifer)
ideas: Swap the 'Chinatown dumplings' description for 'heavy on the MSG', a nod to the barrels.
Swap 'Wines' line for 'Back from the dead. Pour accordingly.'
Add 'Jimmy Jump's fried chicken to go' in place of 'Creamed spinach'.
Swap 'Collected at ten' on the pledge card for 'Vote Frank White for Mayor'.
